summary: Backend (18/18 pytest tests pass after fix) + frontend smoke tested. Auth flows, resumes CRUD, ATS analyze/upload/history, interview gen/history, cover-letter, career advice, jobs CRUD, profile, dashboard summary, 401 guards, brute-force lockout, forgot/reset password all verified. Fixed a critical naive-vs-aware datetime bug in server.py that broke brute-force lockout (500 on 6th attempt) and password reset (500). Frontend register->dashboard flow works; all 8 dashboard routes render without crashes; protected /dashboard redirects to /login when unauth.

minor.issue: Intermittent LLM budget-exceeded response from litellm: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. Endpoint still returned 200 but body was {'error': ...}. On retry all AI endpoints returned valid JSON. Monitor EMERGENT_LLM_KEY quota.

issues: Console errors show 401 from /api/auth/me on public pages (AuthContext calls me() on mount even when unauthenticated). Non-blocking but noisy — consider suppressing 401 for anonymous page loads.

action_items: Monitor EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget — some AI calls got 'Budget has been exceeded' error inconsistently. Retries succeeded, so quota may be throttling.
(Optional) Silence /api/auth/me 401 noise in console for public pages — AuthContext should skip me() if no token indicator or catch 401 silently.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED by testing agent: MongoDB motor client was not tz_aware=True, so datetimes stored as tz-aware UTC came back naive. Any `>` / `<` comparison (login_attempts.locked_until, password_reset_tokens.expires_at) raised TypeError -> 500. Fix: `AsyncIOMotorClient(..., tz_aware=True)` in /app/backend/server.py.
server.py is ~640 lines — approaching threshold; consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/resumes.py, routers/ats.py, etc. for maintainability.

CORS is set to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject credentials with wildcard. It works today because REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL == same origin as frontend (both served via ingress), so cookies are same-site. If used cross-origin later, set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly.
Cookie `secure=False` — acceptable for HTTPS-terminated ingress in dev; set to True in production behind HTTPS.
ai_service errors are wrapped and returned as 200 with {'error': ...}. Consider returning 503 so frontend can retry/show 'AI temporarily unavailable' state.
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own TEST_ prefixed users/resumes/jobs. No manual seed needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env. Uses parallel workers (2). AI endpoints have 90s timeout; may occasionally return 200 with {'error': budget exceeded} — acceptable per spec. Datetime tz fix is in place; do NOT remove tz_aware=True from motor client.
rca of the issue: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Server code used datetime.now(timezone.utc) (aware) when storing/comparing, but PyMongo/Motor by default deserialize BSON datetimes as naive Python datetimes. Comparing them (`la['locked_until'] > now`, `rec['expires_at'] < now`) raised TypeError -> uncaught -> 500. Reproduction: 6 bad login attempts -> 6th returns 500 instead of 429; POST /api/auth/reset-password with valid token -> 500. Mitigation applied: pass tz_aware=True to AsyncIOMotorClient. Post-fix: brute-force returns 429 and reset-password returns 200 as expected.
